import zipfile, tempfile, os, subprocess, pathlib, statistics, json
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/tmp')
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
results={}
for group, zpath in [('animals','inputs/scogs_animals.zip'),('fungi','inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')]:
    td=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'{group}_trees_', dir=str(root))
    vals=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as zf:
        for n in zf.namelist():
            b=n.split('/')[-1]
            if not b.endswith('.treefile'):
                continue
            p=pathlib.Path(td)/b
            p.write_bytes(zf.read(n))
            proc=subprocess.run(['phykit','total_tree_length',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
            lines=[l for l in proc.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
            val=float(lines[0].strip().split()[0])
            vals.append((b,val))
    results[group]=vals
    print(group, 'count', len(vals), 'median', statistics.median(v for _,v in vals))
    out=pathlib.Path('/workspace/tmp')/f'{group}_tree_lengths.tsv'
    out.write_text('\\n'.join(f'{b}\\t{v}' for b,v in vals)+'\\n')
    print('sample first 5', vals[:5])
# fold changes
am=statistics.median(v for _,v in results['animals'])
fm=statistics.median(v for _,v in results['fungi'])
print('animals_median',am,'fungi_median',fm,'fungi/animals',fm/am,'animals/fungi',am/fm)

"""Paired group comparison for BUSCO single-copy ortholog phylogenetics.

This script extracts BOTH `scogs_animals.zip` and `scogs_fungi.zip`,
computes the requested per-ortholog metric on every ortholog, and emits
both per-group summaries AND the cross-group Mann-Whitney U + p-value
in a single invocation. It exists to address timeouts the agent hits
when re-running per-group batches separately.

Why this is faster than calling phykit_batch twice:

- For metrics derivable from alignment columns alone (parsimony_informative,

  per file. ~100x speedup on 500 alignments.

  patristic_distances, evolutionary_rate), it spawns one phykit process
  per file but extracts only ONCE per group. The agent had been re-running

import zipfile, tempfile, pathlib, subprocess, statistics, re
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/tmp'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def newick_edges(s):
    # remove comments, whitespace
    s=s.strip()
    # find all length colon numbers including scientific
    return [float(x) for x in re.findall(r':([0-9.]+(?:[eE][+-]?\\d+)?)', s)]
for group,zpath in [('animals','inputs/scogs_animals.zip'),('fungi','inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')]:
    td=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'manual_{group}_', dir=str(root))
    maxdiff=0; bad=0; n=0; vals=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as zf:
        for name in zf.namelist():
            b=name.split('/')[-1]
            if not b.endswith('.treefile'): continue
            p=pathlib.Path(td)/b; data=zf.read(name); p.write_bytes(data)
            s=data.decode()
            manual=sum(newick_edges(s))
            r=subprocess.run(['phykit','total_tree_length',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True)
            phy=float(r.stdout.strip().split()[0])
            diff=abs(manual-phy); maxdiff=max(maxdiff,diff); n+=1; vals.append(phy)
            if diff>1e-6: bad+=1
    print(group,'n',n,'maxdiff',maxdiff,'bad',bad,'median manual/phy',statistics.median(vals))
